description:
Your to-do list for a long task; it is kept outside your conversation history, so it survives when the history is summarized. It is not shown to you by itself: after a summary, or when you are not sure where you are, call {"op": "ls"} to see it again. Use it when a task has 3 or more steps: write the steps first, mark one in_progress when you start it, completed when it is done; keep at most one in_progress. One op per call; every op prints the whole list:
- {"op": "ls"}
- {"op": "set", "items": ["read the config", "write the parser", "add tests"]}  (replaces the whole list; [] clears it; to drop one item, set the list without it)
- {"op": "add", "text": "update the docs"}  ("after": 2 puts it after item 2, "after": 0 at the top)
- {"op": "mark", "n": 2, "status": "completed"}  (status: pending, in_progress, completed)
Errors: ItemMissing (n is not on the list: ls first), StatusUnknown, ListBad (the saved list is broken: set a new one). Details: knowledge_read aos/tools/todo.json.

op.description: ls = see the list, set = replace the whole list, add = add one item, mark = change one item's status

items.description: set: the whole new list, in order ([] clears it); status of a plain string = pending

text.description: add: the new item, one short line (at most 300 characters)

after.description: add: put it after this item number (0 = at the top; not given = at the end)

json.description: ls: print one JSON object instead of lines
